key.name: drip-style
key.description: liquid: everything that pops out of the top bar (Vitre Controls, Vitre Notices, the volume capsule, every top-bar menu) drips out of its top-bar pill like glass liquid. classic: the measured motion of the earlier builds (Vitre Controls instant, Vitre Notices slide, HUD fade, menus as Liquid Glass / GNOME animate them); the value keeps its old name so saved settings still work. Read by Vitre Controls, Vitre Notices, the menu-bar HUD and this extension; applies to the next pop-out, no login needed.
